crossRefs.note: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be…
until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is…
Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.
The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for…
For Yahweh has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her…
Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for Yahweh has comforted his people. He has redeemed…
Yahweh has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of…
They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities…
Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…
In that day, Yahweh’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of…
In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into…
Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up. It will make…
I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of…
For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord…
“Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over…
I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.

translations.web: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
translations.bsb: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
translations.kjv: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
translations.asv: The wilderness and the dry land shall be glad; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
